terminals.name: frontend-dev
terminals.command: bash -lc 'FRONTEND=""; for d in Lakshmimata /workspace/Lakshmimata /opt/cursor/lakshmimata-stack/Lakshmimata ../Lakshmimata; do if [ -f "$d/package.json" ]; then FRONTEND="$d"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$FRONTEND" ]; then echo "frontend missing — run install.sh first"; exit 1; fi; cd "$FRONTEND" && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173'
terminals.description: Vite React frontend on :5173 using committed Lakshmimata/.env (Supabase anon).
